note: The dataflow of one decoder layer at decode, as nodes and the values each reads. A weight node is named by its tensor's fine role (boltbeam/vocab.py RoleClass) and reads one value through its matrix; every other node is named by what it computes. A value is named by the node that produces it, or is the layer's input stream (residual). The fusion search (search/fusion_space.py) reads this table to say which nodes are adjacent, which values a set of nodes reads from outside, and how BoltBeam computes their output itself (the op column). A node whose op BoltBeam has no reference for (rms_norm, attention) cannot be inside a fusion BoltBeam checks.

kinds.why: Which node ops a captured kernel of a kind (collectors/kernel_kind.py) can be, for the kernel ledger's search-coverage column only (a label, never attribution): a kind with no row here is no node of this graph.

inputs.residual: the residual stream entering the layer

fusion.why: The fusion check's graph ops (this table's `op` column) as rows of neutral ops, applied in turn (the first to the node's first read, each later one with its next read): search/fusion_space.REFERENCE_OPS is read from them and each neutral op's formula is search/fusion_space.FORMULAS, in fp64 pure Python on any weight format, matmul by dequantize and dot, within math/numerics.TOLERANCE of the GPU's output (owner decision 2026-11-20: one formula per op for every check that computes it).
